Plot a heatmap

Source: R/functions.R
plot_heatmap.Rd

Converts a processed HistoneMod percentage table into a peptide-by-sample matrix and renders a heatmap with pheatmap.

Usage

plot_heatmap(
  data_merge,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color_palette = "viridis",
  fontsize = 12,
  fontsize_row = NULL,
  fontsize_col = NULL
)

Arguments

data_merge

A processed data frame containing at least Replicate.Name, Peptide.Note, and Percentage.

cluster_rows

Logical; whether peptides should be clustered.

cluster_cols

Logical; whether samples should be clustered.

color_palette

Character palette name. Supported values are "viridis", "magma", "plasma", "inferno", "cividis", "rocket", "mako", and "turbo".

fontsize

Base font size passed to pheatmap.

fontsize_row

Optional row label font size.

fontsize_col

Optional column label font size.

Value

A pheatmap result object.
